headline: Mercado Libre Shares Fall 15% Following Earnings Miss
summary: Mercado Libre shares dropped 15% in New York after the company reported earnings that fell short of analyst expectations. Investors expressed concern over rising costs associated with customer retention strategies.
why: Mercado Libre is a dominant e-commerce and fintech player in Latin America; its profitability trends are a key indicator for the region's digital economy.

impacts.name: Mercado Libre
impacts.why: Earnings misses and concerns over margin pressure directly impact investor valuation of the stock.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The market reacted negatively to lower-than-expected earnings and the prospect of sustained high expenditure to maintain market share.
